question: What is the average time complexity of a hash map lookup, and when does it get worse?
ideal_answer: O(1) on average. It degrades towards O(n) when many keys land in the same bucket - a weak hash function, a high load factor before resizing, or deliberately chosen colliding keys.

question: What is the difference between a stack and a queue? Give one use for each.
ideal_answer: A stack is last-in first-out; a queue is first-in first-out. A stack suits undo history or depth-first traversal; a queue suits job scheduling or breadth-first traversal.
